_comment: Example for aruco_board.py. Copy to aruco_layout.json and write the real values measured at ASSAR. All in mm, in the board's own frame: x to the right and y down as seen from the camera, origin at the top-left corner of the 3x3 grid.
_markers_mm: Centre of each marker (by id), measured with a ruler on the board, or with the robot TCP (then x, y are the robot's, in mm). At least 4; 6 is better to spot a badly measured one.
_board_corners_mm: The 4 outer corners of the 3x3 grid: top-left, top-right, bottom-right, bottom-left. Used to write board_corners_px into board_config.json.
